summary: Map known staging changes without full runtime fallback.
details: Seven existing browser and material-audit test paths now have explicit impact mappings. Their baseline compiler and package checks and immutable-input controls remain selected; missing mappings no longer expand a staging change into the full runtime suite.

The focused assurance mode exercises the actual impact selector without engine stages, clones or packages. Unknown and mixed runtime harness changes still escalate, and player runtime source retains broader checks. Native acceptance remains a separate affected-profile obligation.
